listing.name: Hull Livery
listing.summary: Hull livery change: install hull mod on ship to change ship sprite. Currently available (only for ship Eagle): Persean (Vanilla enhanced), Hegemony, LG, LC, Tritach, Civilian, Pather, Pirate, Phase, Factory unpainted, Special. For Radiant: Vanilla enhanced and Vanilla enhanced-alt.
listing.aiSummary: Installs hull mods to change ship sprites and apply different faction liveries.

description: Hull livery change: install hull mod on ship to change ship sprite. Currently available (only for ship Eagle): Persean (Vanilla enhanced), Hegemony, LG, LC, Tritach, Civilian, Pather, Pirate, Phase, Factory unpainted, Special. For Radiant: Vanilla enhanced and Vanilla enhanced-alt. List of permitted ships prevents crashing game by installing on incompatible hull.

aiDescription: Installs hull mods to change ship sprites and apply different faction liveries. Currently available liveries include Persean, Hegemony, LG, LC, Tritach, Civilian, Pather, Pirate, Phase, Factory unpainted, and Special for the Eagle, and Vanilla enhanced variants for the Radiant. A list of permitted ships prevents crashing the game by installing on incompatible hulls.
